# Instagram Follower Tracker

Instagram Follower Tracker: https://instafollowtracker.com/

> Instagram Follower Tracker is an independently operated web tool for analysing follower relationships from an official Instagram data export. Core ZIP analysis does not require an Instagram login or password.

## What This Tool Does

Instagram Follower Tracker helps users analyse their Instagram follower relationships by parsing official Instagram data export files. The tool works entirely in the browser for guest users, with optional account features for saving historical snapshots.

From a single export, users can identify:
- Mutual followers (accounts that follow each other)
- Non-followers (accounts the user follows that don't follow back)
- Followers the user doesn't follow back
- Pending follow requests

Comparing two exports from different dates reveals:
- New followers since the last snapshot
- Lost followers (unfollowers) between snapshots
- Changes in follower counts over time

## How It Works

1. User requests an Instagram data export through Instagram's official "Download your information" feature
2. User selects only "Followers and following" under Connections, JSON format, All time range
3. Instagram emails a download link within minutes to hours
4. User uploads the ZIP file to Instagram Follower Tracker
5. The tool parses the JSON files in the browser (no server upload for guest users)
6. Results are displayed in a categorized dashboard with search, filter, and CSV export options

## Privacy and Security

- No Instagram password required for core ZIP analysis
- Guest analysis stays in browser sessionStorage only
- Signed-in users can explicitly save derived data (usernames, counts, relationships) for history
- Raw ZIP files are never uploaded or stored on servers
- An optional OAuth feature exists only for Instagram Professional accounts and is separate from ZIP analysis

## Key Limitations

- Results depend entirely on what Instagram includes in the export
- A single export cannot show historical unfollowers (requires two dated snapshots)
- Deleted, deactivated, or renamed accounts may affect accuracy
- The tool measures follower relationships, not engagement or content performance
